active_continuity: The Star-Array Grand Banquet's three-day preliminaries have ended, and applicants have one free day before the main event.
Jin Taekyung took unanimous first place overall with perfect scores in all five preliminary assessments.
Taekyung defeated the Iron-Water Divine Dragon, Kunlun Cloud Dragon, and Divine Marvel Dragon, all members of the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes.
The Beggars' Sect's Successor Beggar was comparable to those young prodigies, and the Hunroe Leg was a renowned Peak master.
The Iron-Water Divine Dragon abandoned the Star-Array Grand Banquet and returned to the Yangtze.
Kwak Cheolyung lost five thousand silver nyang betting on the preliminaries, mortgaged his retirement estate and land, and was left with only a few iron coins.
The gambling den's account says the Gold-Faced Young Master bet on Taekyung and won tens of thousands of silver nyang in Dodo.
Jeok Cheongang is publicly Taekyung's Master, is proud of Taekyung's result, and has already bragged about him to the Jin Family leadership.
